responsibility: This header defines the call-expansion interface and the function_arg_info abstraction used to describe ABI-level arguments during RTL call lowering. It publishes helpers for call flags, alloca/setjmp recognition, pass-by-reference and must-pass-in-stack decisions, call address preparation, expand_call/tail-call fixups, static-chain handling, and related ABI queries that other expanders use when constructing calls.
same_name_distinction: Interface header in the `calls` group: it defines `function_arg_info` and declares call/ABI helpers used by other expander code, whereas `gcc/calls.cc` contains the actual RTL call-generation logic.
